description: Check one email address without sending to it: syntax (RFC 5322 dot-atom, length limits), whether the domain is on the open disposable-domain list (disposable-email-domains, CC0), and whether the domain can receive mail (MX records, a null MX, or the A record fallback) over DNS over HTTPS. Returns verdict (invalid, undeliverable, risky for a throwaway domain, deliverable_domain, or unknown when DNS failed), the mail hosts, role_account (info@, sales@...), free_provider and a did_you_mean for a common typo. The mailbox is never contacted (no SMTP probe), so it cannot show whether the person exists; only the domain leaves our service. Costs 1 credit. Every row has name (platform/collection/id), kind, its fields and source {platform, url, license, attribution, fetched_at, terms_url}; quote source.attribution when you show a row.

email.description: The email address, such as info@example.com.
